collisionRules: One recurring character, weapon family, tool, terminal or vehicle chassis per generation call.
Never ask ImageGen for multiple named sheets in one image or for raw and normalized outputs together.
Raw path is unique and normalization writes only to the matching normalized path after alpha/grid QA.
The historical Leila slug remains leila-s-rensen in IDs and filenames.
Canon-gated weapons do not enter generation until one exact source model is selected; a name alone is not a visual reference.
